title: Wildlife and Tourism in Eastern Africa
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): Serengeti, Ngorongoro (Tanzania); Bwindi, Queen Elizabeth (Uganda); Volcanoes National Park (Rwanda, mountain gorillas); Maasai Mara, Tsavo, Amboseli (Kenya).

skills.key_step: The child explains the factors that promote tourism.

floor.question: Name one tourist attraction in Kenya.
floor.answer: any attraction such as the Maasai Mara

steps: List what a tourist needs to reach and enjoy it.

board.do: Draw a park with a road and a hotel.

misconceptions.ask: What do airports and hotels do for tourism?
misconceptions.repair: Follow a tourist from home to the park.

misconceptions.ask: What does insecurity do to tourism?
misconceptions.repair: Ask whether a family would visit an unsafe place.

misconceptions.ask: A country has many animals but no roads or hotels near the park. Will many tourists come?
misconceptions.repair: Plan a trip: list what you need besides the animals.

misconceptions.ask: Why do many tourists come in the dry season?
misconceptions.repair: Compare a muddy road in the rains with a dry one.

checks.question: Give two factors that promote tourism.
checks.answer: any two of: wildlife and attractions, peace and security, roads and airports, hotels, climate, advertising

skills.key_step: The child places the main parks and reserves of Eastern Africa in their countries.

misconceptions.ask: In which country is the Serengeti National Park?
misconceptions.repair: Say Serengeti is south of the border and Mara is north.

misconceptions.ask: Where can mountain gorillas be seen?
misconceptions.repair: Say gorillas live in forest on mountains.

misconceptions.ask: In which country is the Ngorongoro Crater?
misconceptions.repair: Pin each park on the regional map.

misconceptions.ask: Where in Eastern Africa can mountain gorillas be seen?
misconceptions.repair: Show the gorilla range on the map.

checks.question: In which country is the Serengeti?
Where can mountain gorillas be seen?
checks.answer: Bwindi in Uganda or the Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda

skills.key_step: The child pairs the challenges of tourism with their solutions.

floor.question: Give one factor that promotes tourism.

board.do: Write poaching, poor roads, human-wildlife conflict.
Wait for patrols and strict laws.

misconceptions.ask: What does poaching do to tourism?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what is left to see if animals are killed.
Ask which answer stops a poacher.

misconceptions.ask: Elephants destroy crops near a park. What is a good solution?
misconceptions.repair: Show a beehive fence that keeps elephants out.

misconceptions.ask: How can a country bring more tourists?

checks.question: Give one solution to human-wildlife conflict.
checks.answer: any of: fences, compensation, community conservancies
